description: No clean rule; a diffuse, left-right asymmetric mix. Tends to fire in early-to-middle games (about 8-16 stones) when the opponent's stones sit on the bottom row, in the centre column (rows 2-3) or on the edges, not in columns 2 and 4 above the bottom row. A full centre column and late games suppress it. Particular stacks matter strongly but only in context.
effect: None measurable: forcing it off or to max changes move probabilities by at most about 0.05.
notes: Scored 4 hypotheses: ply+no O in cols 2/4 (F1 0.096, AUROC 0.60), opponent vertical three (0.072), connectivity combo (0.074), cell-cue score (0.115, AUROC 0.57, sim share 0.04, submitted). Minimal pairs show strong context dependence and left-right asymmetry (mirror of a 2.12 position gives -0.03). Firing alternates with side to move within a game. Steer shows no effect. Probably a random or mixed direction. Synthesis 2.187 beats dev max 2.123.
